name: Zoo Guides (Youth Volunteers)
org: Point Defiance Zoo & Aquarium (Metro Parks Tacoma)
what_you_do: Talk with zoo guests about the animals and about conservation and the environment. Lead hands-on activities in exhibit areas. After a summer season you can help at special events. Youth volunteers do not do animal care.
grades: Grades 9 to 12 (seniors graduating in spring can still apply)
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 18 and in grades 9 to 12. You should be excited to talk with visitors about nature and animals.
duration: 9 required trainings March to June, then one 6-hour shift a week for 10 weeks in summer
deadline_text: Applications are closed now. The page says Zoo Guide applications open in December 2026 (no exact day posted). Interviews are in late February 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply on the youth volunteer page in December 2026. Large and small group interviews are held in late February; not everyone is interviewed. Join the waitlist form to get an email when applications open.
notes: Most zoo volunteer roles ask for at least one year. Explore the Shore (ages 16 and up) and Spot the Swallows (14 and up with a parent if under 18) are other teen options on the volunteer page. Questions: volunteer@pdza.org or 253-404-3687.
